<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"

  <bpmn:message id="Message_FirstChainsaw" name="First chainsaw"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CustomerDecision" name="Customer decision"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_ChainsawProduction" name="Chainsaw" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_CustomerProperties" name="Customer provides properties">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CustomerProperties" messageRef="Message_CustomerProperties"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderParts" name="Order parts from various online sources in parallel"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveParts" name="Receive parts"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_InspectParts" name="Inspect all parts"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ProductionAndUpdates_Split" name="Produce and send updates"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssembleFirstChainsaw" name="Assemble the first chainsaw"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendFirstChainsaw" name="Send first chainsaw to customer" messageRef="Message_FirstChainsaw"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveCustomerDecision" name="Receive customer's decision" messageRef="Message_CustomerDecision"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CustomerDecision" name="Does the customer like the first chainsaw?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProduceRemainingChainsaws" name="Produce the remaining chainsaws"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CustomerDecision_Merge" name="Continue or finish production"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendUpdates" name="Send regular updates to customer" messageRef="Message_CustomerUpdate">
      <bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics>
        <bpmn:loopCondition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">production is ongoing</bpmn:loopCondition>
      </bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ProductionAndUpdates_Join" name="Production and updates complete"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ProductionComplete" name="Production finished"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Order" sourceRef="Start_CustomerProperties" targetRef="Task_OrderParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Order_Receive" sourceRef="Task_OrderParts" targetRef="Task_ReceiveParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Receive_Inspect" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveParts" targetRef="Task_InspectParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inspect_Split" sourceRef="Task_InspectParts" targetRef="Gateway_ProductionAndUpdates_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Assembly" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductionAndUpdates_Split" targetRef="Task_AssembleFirstChainsaw"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Updates" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductionAndUpdates_Split" targetRef="Task_SendUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Assembly_SendFirst" sourceRef="Task_AssembleFirstChainsaw" targetRef="Task_SendFirstChainsaw"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendFirst_ReceiveDecision" sourceRef="Task_SendFirstChainsaw" targetRef="Task_ReceiveCustomerDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveDecision_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveCustomerDecision" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Decision_ProduceRemaining" name="Customer likes it" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerDecision" targetRef="Task_ProduceRemainingChainsaws">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">customer likes the first chainsaw</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Decision_NotLiked" name="Customer does not like it" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerDecision" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerDecision_Merge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">customer does not like the first chainsaw</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Remaining_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ProduceRemainingChainsaws" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerDecision_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_Join" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerDecision_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_ProductionAndUpdates_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Updates_Join" sourceRef="Task_SendUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_ProductionAndUpdates_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_End" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductionAndUpdates_Join" targetRef="End_ProductionComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Chainsaw">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Manufacturer" name="Chainsaw producer" processRef="Process_ChainsawProduction"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CustomerProperties" name="Chainsaw properties" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_CustomerProperties" messageRef="Message_CustomerProperties"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ProductionUpdate" name="Production update" sourceRef="Task_SendUpdates" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_CustomerUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FirstChainsaw" name="First chainsaw" sourceRef="Task_SendFirstChainsaw" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_FirstChainsaw"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CustomerDecision" name="Customer decision" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveCustomerDecision" messageRef="Message_CustomerDecision"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_Chainsaw"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/chainsaw">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CustomerProperties" name="Chainsaw properties"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ProductionUpdate" name="Production update"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_FirstChainsaw" name="First chainsaw"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CustomerDecision" name="Customer decision"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_ChainsawProduction" name="Chainsaw" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_CustomerProperties" name="Customer provides chainsaw properties">
      <bpmn:documentation>The properties include at least five specifications, such as guide bar length (Schwertlaenge), chain width, and electric or motor chainsaw type.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_CustomerProperties" messageRef="Message_CustomerProperties"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderParts" name="Order parts from various online sources">
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="false"/>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_PartsArrive" name="All parts arrive"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_InspectParts" name="Inspect all parts"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ProductionUpdatesSplit" name="Produce and send updates"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProduceFirstChainsaw" name="Produce the first chainsaw"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendFirstChainsaw" name="Send the first chainsaw to the customer" messageRef="Message_FirstChainsaw"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveCustomerDecision" name="Receive the customer's decision" messageRef="Message_CustomerDecision"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CustomerDecision" name="Does the customer like the first chainsaw?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProduceRemainingChainsaws" name="Produce the rest of the order"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ProductionPathsMerge" name="Merge production outcomes"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendProductionUpdate" name="Send a production update to the customer" messageRef="Message_ProductionUpdate">
      <bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics testBefore="false">
        <bpmn:loopCondition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Production is ongoing</bpmn:loopCondition>
      </bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ProductionUpdatesJoin" name="Production and updates complete"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Production" name="Production finished"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_OrderParts" sourceRef="Start_CustomerProperties" targetRef="Task_OrderParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderParts_Arrive" sourceRef="Task_OrderParts" targetRef="Event_PartsArrive"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Arrive_Inspect" sourceRef="Event_PartsArrive" targetRef="Task_InspectParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inspect_Split" sourceRef="Task_InspectParts" targetRef="Gateway_ProductionUpdatesSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_ProduceFirst" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductionUpdatesSplit" targetRef="Task_ProduceFirstChainsaw"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_SendUpdate" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductionUpdatesSplit" targetRef="Task_SendProductionUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProduceFirst_SendFirst" sourceRef="Task_ProduceFirstChainsaw" targetRef="Task_SendFirstChainsaw"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendFirst_ReceiveDecision" sourceRef="Task_SendFirstChainsaw" targetRef="Task_ReceiveCustomerDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveDecision_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveCustomerDecision" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Decision_ProduceRest" name="Customer likes it" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerDecision" targetRef="Task_ProduceRemainingChainsaws">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The customer likes the first chainsaw</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Decision_NoRest" name="Customer does not like it" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerDecision" targetRef="Gateway_ProductionPathsMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The customer does not like the first chainsaw</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProduceRest_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ProduceRemainingChainsaws" targetRef="Gateway_ProductionPathsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_Join" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductionPathsMerge" targetRef="Gateway_ProductionUpdatesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendUpdate_Join" sourceRef="Task_SendProductionUpdate" targetRef="Gateway_ProductionUpdatesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_End" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductionUpdatesJoin" targetRef="End_Production"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Chainsaw">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Producer" name="Chainsaw producer" processRef="Process_ChainsawProduction"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CustomerProperties" name="Chainsaw properties" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Start_CustomerProperties" messageRef="Message_CustomerProperties"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ProductionUpdate" name="Production update" sourceRef="Task_SendProductionUpdate" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_ProductionUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FirstChainsaw" name="First chainsaw" sourceRef="Task_SendFirstChainsaw" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_FirstChainsaw"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CustomerDecision" name="Customer decision" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveCustomerDecision" messageRef="Message_CustomerDecision"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
